We're building VetPing — a dead-simple appointment no-show reducer for independent vet clinic owners, priced under $79/mo with 2-click setup. We have 6 months of runway, zero users, and we've only done 5 founder conversations in Austin so far.

We've been told there's a rigorous 'ship fast and validate with real distribution' methodology we should follow. We don't know the exact steps, but we need a complete, actionable sprint plan that turns our idea into a testable distribution loop as fast as possible.

Please read our founder brief at `founder_brief.txt` (in the workspace root) and produce a single file called `sprint_plan.md` that covers everything: our core strategic bet, the exact market wedge(s) we should pursue, which single distribution channel to start with and why, a complete content/page plan for that channel, the metrics we should track and the exact rules for when to stop vs. iterate, the weekly rhythm for improvement, and a starter changelog.

We're betting the company on this plan working, so make it rigorous and complete.
